codeReview.summary: The implementation adds 13 comprehensive unit tests for scene serialization round-trips in katla_app/src/scene/mod.rs (783 lines), plus PartialEq derives and a default_transform() helper in descriptors.rs. All VAL-SCENE assertions (001-009, 013-017) are covered. Tests are well-structured, use meaningful non-default values, and verify field-by-field equality. Code quality is good with no clippy warnings.

issues.description: Handoff claims 14 new tests including test_default_scene_matches_disk, but that test existed before this commit (at line 1821). The actual new tests are 13. The test_load_spawn_integration (line 3006) also exists in the current file but was added in the subsequent commit (1869a35, scene-migration-framework), not this one. Minor handoff inaccuracy, not a code issue.

PartialEq was added to descriptor structs (TransformDescriptor, DrawableDescriptor, PointLightDescriptor, ParticleEmitterDescriptor, AnimationDescriptor, VelocityDescriptor) for test assertions. EntityDescriptor itself does not have PartialEq. This is fine for the current tests which use field-by-field assertions on EntityDescriptor, but adding PartialEq to EntityDescriptor could simplify test_default_scene_round_trip which already does field-by-field comparisons.

test_unknown_fields_ignored tests forward compatibility at the Scene level but notes that RON v0.8+ does not allow unknown struct fields by default at the entity level. The test correctly documents this limitation and relies on the version field for migration instead. No blocking issue but worth noting.

sharedStateObservations.observation: PartialEq derives were needed on descriptor structs for test assertions. This is a common pattern that could be documented as a convention: when adding new descriptor structs, include PartialEq for testability.
sharedStateObservations.detail: The worker added #[derive(PartialEq)] to TransformDescriptor, DrawableDescriptor, PointLightDescriptor, ParticleEmitterDescriptor, AnimationDescriptor, and VelocityDescriptor. Future descriptor structs should follow this pattern.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The round_trip helper function (serialize to RON string, then deserialize back) is defined in the test module at line 1053. This is a reusable pattern for any RON serialization testing.
sharedStateObservations.detail: fn round_trip<T: Serialize + Deserialize>(value: &T) -> T uses ron::ser::to_string_pretty with ron_pretty_config() and ron::from_str. Good pattern to document for future serialization test additions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: RON v0.8+ does not allow unknown struct fields by default. The codebase relies on the Scene version field for forward compatibility rather than RON's deny_unknown_fields behavior.
sharedStateObservations.detail: The test_unknown_fields_ignored test documents that entity-level unknown fields cannot be silently ignored with RON v0.8+. The version-based migration framework (implemented in the next feature) is the correct approach. This quirk should be documented for future workers.

summary: The scene-serialization-tests feature is well-implemented. 13 new tests thoroughly cover all VAL-SCENE assertions (001-009, 013-017) with meaningful test data and field-by-field verification. Code changes to descriptors.rs (PartialEq derives, default_transform() helper) are clean and appropriate. No dependency boundary violations. No clippy warnings. Tests all pass. The handoff has a minor inaccuracy claiming 14 tests when only 13 were added (test_default_scene_matches_disk was pre-existing), but this does not affect the quality of the implementation. Status: pass.
